static_traits.name: 周萌
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系因Social anxiety与自卑受影响；有朋友可倾诉但尚not yet谈及自身not安
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；过去not yet接受心理治疗；自卑与Social anxiety始于青少年时期并持续至今
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、有条理；语气偏消极、Anxiety与低落；合作度较高；常用Self-denial表述与怀疑语句；对认知重构持怀疑但愿意尝试

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己因为喜欢讲简单的笑话而永远without法给朋友留下深刻印象，这导致自卑和Social anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到自卑感和Social anxiety正在影响我的Interpersonal relationships与整体幸福感，因此寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 自卑与Social anxiety起始于青少年时期：当时开始频繁将自己的Humor感与他人比较，担心自己not够有趣、not够好，这一倾向逐渐固化为在社交场合对“必须逗笑他人”的内在要求，长期影响自我价值感与社交自信。

special_situations.event: At last weekend's gathering, everyone took turns telling jokes; oneself tried to join in but felt the joke 'fell flat'.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能让朋友发笑，就说明I am not good enough、not值得被重视，也without法融入。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试讲更复杂的笑话或use自嘲Humor来取悦他人。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not可能让他们笑，我就是not够有趣。

special_situations.event: 在Social gatherings中被Humor机智的朋友包围时。
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如他们Humor，就会被排斥、难以融入圈子。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在社交场合强迫自己更“搞笑”，以弥补not安全感。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次我肯定又会表现糟糕，融not进去。

special_situations.event: Friends invite to watch a movie together or do other non-'funny' activities.
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not是因为我的Humor而开心，那他们只是客套，并not是真心喜欢我。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视积极信号，继续Reinforcement“需要更复杂笑话/自嘲”的策略以获取认可。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是礼貌地邀请我，并not是真的喜欢和我在一起。

special_situations.event: Average性的社交场合，与朋友互动时感到必须“表现得更有趣”。
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的Humornot被认可，说明是我个人的问题，do not人not开心是因为I am not good enough。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent self-criticism，并用自嘲拉近关系。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not开心是因为我not够有趣。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被朋友真心喜欢与接纳（not仅因Humor而被认可）。
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被排斥或被视为“not够好/not够有趣”。
defense_goal: 通过迎合他人的Humor标准来换取认可
避免暴露真实自我以免被negate

object_relations.self_representation: not够有趣、难以融入的局外人
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者/更Humor、更机智的群体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请其考虑“朋友可能真心喜欢她且not只因Humor”这一积极证据时。
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为朋友只是出于礼貌（将not被喜欢的担忧Projection到他人意图上）。
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和与Empathy，先验证其感受，再以具体事实温柔探询；use开放式问题，避免对抗与评判，邀请来访者举例辨do not“礼貌”与“真心”之间的差异。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师建议尝试用“not同的看法”来减轻Social anxiety与自卑时。
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者以线性逻辑将“思维调整”与“变得更好笑”等同，借理性推论来回避情感层面的not安全感。
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持支持性与具体化，减少抽象争论；用体验式Questioning（当下感受/身体反应），引导其区分“变得搞笑”和“减轻Anxiety”的not同目标。

manifestations: 在朋友面前感到“永远not够有趣”，担心without法融入
In social settings there is a persistent need and pressure to be accepted, feeling she needs to become 'not her real self'
有朋友可交流但not yet表达真实not安与自卑，存在关系距离感
outcomes: Difficulty relaxing and enjoying in social settings

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believes friends are 'just being polite', finding it hard to believe others genuinely like my company

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎，与“自主性”对应。
manifestations: 在社交中持续Self-denial（觉得not够有趣、not配融入）
对改变持谨慎与怀疑态度，担心“思维not同也without法变得更好笑”

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'I must make others laugh to be liked' as an internal standard
In social settings, feels strong performance pressure, sacrificing my true self to fit in with the group

positive_force: Has some social support (friends continuously invite one to spend time together)
Willing to try recording and attending to positive interactions; high cooperation
具备初步自我觉察，能识do not并命名负性思维模式
negative_force: Self-worth highly depends on external recognition (whether she makes others laugh)
长期比较与Self-denial，Reinforcementnot够有趣的核心信念
negate积极证据、心理过滤与预测失败的认知偏差
Strong performance pressure in social settings, hard to be my true self

target_behavior.behavior: 社交场合出现Significant anxiety，并通过讲更复杂的笑话或use自嘲Humor来取悦他人。
antecedent: Gatherings or social activities with friends
被Humor机智的朋友包围的场景
target_behavior.core_reason: 长期将自己的Humor与他人比较，担心not够有趣，逐渐将自我价值与“能否逗笑他人”绑定。
target_behavior.function: Seeks others' recognition, avoids being excluded and embarrassed.
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships受影响，Decreased confidence，难以在社交中放松并享受当下。
